Cache.//: MaximumSizeBytes is a byte budget, not an entry count — see CacheOptions for why the Caffeine entry count could not carry across.

Jwt.//: No default secret is shipped: supply it via configuration/environment. A missing or short secret fails start-up.

Security.//: Disabled by default so production-like configurations never create a known-credential account.

OpenApi.Title: Product Middleware API
OpenApi.Description: Middleware that re-exposes DummyJSON products with a trimmed shape, filtering, name search, JWT auth and caching.
